column1: # Original DICE Rebound, DIP 0 (11 points, 1 coin / 1 credit). Start without a credit
# (200 ms), coin without Start (500 ms), then Start; each horizontal paddle sweeps its
# full range alone (2000-4500 ms); a recorded closed-loop rally (5000-14800 ms) gives
# paddle contacts; then both paddles park at their outer ends until the game ends
# (right side reaches 11); coin and Start restart a cleared game. Original SDL int16 axes.
